name: Yagmoth Demon
tagline: Altered cards forged in blood & black ink
about: Yagmoth Demon is an artist working in the dark corners of Magic: The Gathering – extending, repainting and reimagining cards until they look like they crawled out of the Swamp themselves.
The name comes from the Old School legend Yawgmoth Demon: a six-mana, first-strike, flying nightmare that demands a heavy price. The work follows the same rule – nothing here is made cheaply.
Alters are hand-painted on real cards, sealed and shipped protected. Swag is produced in small, numbered runs.
